remaining_cautions.evidence_context: Primary S1 Fig identifies Pep18 as cyclic c(FFWRRVK), while the merged DBAASP sequence catalog stores FFWRRVK without cyclic notation. Final records preserve this explicitly.

DBAASP aggregate rows for Escherichia coli and Pseudomonas aeruginosa clinical isolate ranges, plus one duplicate Enterobacter cloacae endpoint label, do not exactly match Table 1 and remain source_conflict rather than source_verified.
DBAASP links only Pep18, but the paper treats Pep16/Pep19 as the active lead candidates; final mechanism claims avoid overclaiming Pep18-specific efficacy.
